movement_description: Prepare by sitting with hands resting on thighs, palms down. Then, raise the right hand to shoulder height with fingers extended and thumb parallel to palm, palm facing forward. Move the hand in a smooth arc from the shoulder down to the hip, keeping the palm facing forward. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to shoulder height, extending fingers, and palm forward, then moving it down to the hip. Finally, return to the initial resting position with hands on thighs, palms down.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on thighs, palms down. Then, raise the right hand to shoulder height with fingers extended and thumb parallel to palm, palm facing forward. Move the hand in a smooth arc from the shoulder down to the hip, keeping the palm facing forward. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to shoulder height, extending fingers, and palm forward, then moving it down to the hip. Finally, return to the initial resting position with hands on thighs, palms down.

Start with your right arm extended upward and your palm facing outward. Then, smoothly lower your right arm to your side while keeping your palm facing downward. Next, raise your right arm again, this time with your palm facing upward, and move it in a circular motion around your body. Finally, return your right arm to your side with your palm facing downward. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the process.

Start with your right arm extended upward and your palm facing outward. Then, smoothly lower your right arm to your side while keeping your palm facing downward. Next, raise your right arm again, this time with your palm facing upward, and move it in a circular motion around your body. Finally, return your right arm to your side with your palm facing downward. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the process.

Start with your right hand resting at your side, palm facing inward. Raise your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing outward, then move it forward and down to touch your chest. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing outward, moving it forward and down to touch your chest again.

Start with your right hand resting at your side, palm facing inward. Raise your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing outward, then move it forward and down to touch your chest. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing outward, moving it forward and down to touch your chest again.

Start with both hands resting at your sides. Raise your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing forward, then move it upward and slightly backward to form a 'V' shape with your fingers. Hold this position briefly. Next, lower your right hand to your side while keeping your left hand resting at your side. Repeat the raising and forming of the 'V' shape with your right hand, ensuring the movement is smooth and deliberate. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the process.

Start with both hands resting at your sides. Raise your right hand to shoulder height, palm facing forward, then move it upward and slightly backward to form a 'V' shape with your fingers. Hold this position briefly. Next, lower your right hand to your side while keeping your left hand resting at your side. Repeat the raising and forming of the 'V' shape with your right hand, ensuring the movement is smooth and deliberate. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the process.

To sign 'BAPTISE', begin with your right hand resting at your side, palm facing inward. Then, raise your right hand to the forehead, palm facing upward, and move it down to the chest, palm facing inward. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to the forehead, palm facing upward, and moving it down to the chest, palm facing inward. Finally, return your right hand to the side, palm facing inward, while maintaining a neutral facial expression.

To sign 'BAPTISE', begin with your right hand resting at your side, palm facing inward. Then, raise your right hand to the forehead, palm facing upward, and move it down to the chest, palm facing inward. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to the forehead, palm facing upward, and moving it down to the chest, palm facing inward. Finally, return your right hand to the side, palm facing inward, while maintaining a neutral facial expression.

Prepare by resting both hands at your sides. Then, raise your right hand to shoulder height with fingers extended and palm facing forward. Move your right hand in a smooth arc from the shoulder down to the side of your body, keeping the palm facing forward. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height again, extending fingers and facing the palm forward, then moving it in the same arc down to the side of your body. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sign.

Prepare by resting both hands at your sides. Then, raise your right hand to shoulder height with fingers extended and palm facing forward. Move your right hand in a smooth arc from the shoulder down to the side of your body, keeping the palm facing forward. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height again, extending fingers and facing the palm forward, then moving it in the same arc down to the side of your body. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sign.

Start with the right hand resting at the side, then raise it to the forehead, palm facing outward, and move it down to the right shoulder, palm facing inward. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to the forehead, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the right shoulder, palm facing inward. Finally, return the right hand to the side, palm facing inward.

Start with the right hand resting at the side, then raise it to the forehead, palm facing outward, and move it down to the right shoulder, palm facing inward. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to the forehead, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the right shoulder, palm facing inward. Finally, return the right hand to the side, palm facing inward.

Start with the left hand resting at the side, then move it upward and across the head to the right side of the head, palm facing outward. Repeat this motion by returning the left hand to the side and moving it upward and across the head to the right side of the head, palm facing outward. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sequence.

Start with the left hand resting at the side, then move it upward and across the head to the right side of the head, palm facing outward. Repeat this motion by returning the left hand to the side and moving it upward and across the head to the right side of the head, palm facing outward. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sequence.

Begin with the right hand resting at the side, palm facing inward. Move the right hand upward and forward in a smooth arc, palm facing outward, ending with the hand positioned above the head. Repeat this motion by returning the right hand to the starting position and initiating the movement again before resting.

Begin with the right hand resting at the side, palm facing inward. Move the right hand upward and forward in a smooth arc, palm facing outward, ending with the hand positioned above the head. Repeat this motion by returning the right hand to the starting position and initiating the movement again before resting.

First, prepare by standing with arms relaxed at your sides. Then, actively sign by raising your right hand to shoulder height with the palm facing forward and fingers extended, moving it in a smooth arc downward toward your chest. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height with the palm facing forward and fingers extended, moving it in a smooth arc downward toward your chest. Finally, return to the starting position with arms relaxed at your sides.

First, prepare by standing with arms relaxed at your sides. Then, actively sign by raising your right hand to shoulder height with the palm facing forward and fingers extended, moving it in a smooth arc downward toward your chest. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height with the palm facing forward and fingers extended, moving it in a smooth arc downward toward your chest. Finally, return to the starting position with arms relaxed at your sides.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on lap. Begin the sign by raising the right hand to the forehead, palm facing inward, then move it down and across the body to the left side, palm facing outward. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to the forehead, palm facing inward, then moving it down and across the body to the left side, palm facing outward. Return to the resting position with hands on lap.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on lap. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to the forehead, palm facing inward, then moving it down and across the body to the left side, palm facing outward. Return to the resting position with hands on lap.

To sign 'BRIGHTNESS', begin by resting both hands on the lap with palms facing down. Then, raise the right hand to the forehead, palm facing outward, and move it down to the right side of the chest. Next, repeat the motion with the left hand, raising it to the forehead, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the left side of the chest. Finally, return both hands to the lap with palms facing down.

To sign 'BRIGHTNESS', begin by resting both hands on the lap with palms facing down. Then, raise the right hand to the forehead, palm facing outward, and move it down to the right side of the chest. Next, repeat the motion with the left hand, raising it to the forehead, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the left side of the chest. Finally, return both hands to the lap with palms facing down.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on thighs. Initiate the sign by raising the right hand to the mouth, palm facing inward, then moving it downward and outward to the right side of the body. Repeat this motion by raising the right hand to the mouth, palm facing inward, moving it downward and outward to the right side of the body. Conclude by returning the right hand to the resting position on the thigh.

Prepare by standing with hands at sides. Begin with the right hand raised to the mouth, palm facing inward, then lower it to the chest. Next, move the right hand to the mouth, palm facing inward, and repeat this motion twice. Finally, return the right hand to the sides while keeping the head upright and eyes forward.

Prepare by standing with hands at sides. Begin with the right hand raised to the mouth, palm facing inward, then lower it to the chest. Next, move the right hand to the mouth, palm facing inward, and repeat this motion twice. Finally, return the right hand to the sides while keeping the head upright and eyes forward.

First, prepare by standing with your left hand resting at your side and your right hand hanging naturally by your side. Then, actively sign by raising your right hand to the side of your head, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the center of your chest, palm facing inward. Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to the side of your head, palm facing outward, and moving it down to the center of your chest, palm facing inward. Finally, return to rest by lowering your right hand to your side and keeping your left hand resting at your side.

First, prepare by standing with your left hand resting at your side and your right hand hanging naturally by your side. Finally, return to rest by lowering your right hand to your side and keeping your left hand resting at your side.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on thighs. Initiate the sign by raising the right hand to shoulder height with fingers extended and palm facing forward. Prepare by standing with hands at sides, then raise the right hand to the right side of the head with fingers extended and palm facing outward. Move the right hand in a circular motion from the right side of the head down to the right shoulder, then back up to the right side of the head. Repeat this circular motion twice, ensuring the hand returns to the starting position before moving again. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sign.

Prepare by standing with hands at sides, then raise the right hand to the right side of the head with fingers extended and palm facing outward. Repeat this circular motion twice, ensuring the hand returns to the starting position before moving again. Maintain a neutral facial expression throughout the sign.

Prepare by holding your right hand with fingers extended and thumb slightly curved, palm facing forward, starting at your chest level. Then, move your right hand upward and forward in a smooth arc, keeping the palm facing forward, until it reaches a position above your head. Next, bring your right hand down and across your body, palm facing inward, stopping at your waist. Finally, return your right hand to the starting position at chest level, palm facing forward, and repeat the sequence starting from the initial position.

Next, bring your right hand down and across your body, palm facing inward, stopping at your waist. Finally, return your right hand to the starting position at chest level, palm facing forward, and repeat the sequence starting from the initial position.

Repeat this motion by raising your right hand to shoulder height with the palm facing outward, moving it downward and across your body to the left side while keeping the palm facing outward. Prepare by holding both hands at your sides with palms facing inward. Begin the sign by raising your right hand to chest level with the palm facing outward, then move it downward to your lower abdomen while keeping the palm facing outward. Next, bring your left hand to the same chest level position with the palm facing outward, moving it down to your lower abdomen in the same direction. Repeat the sequence by raising your right hand to chest level with the palm facing outward, moving it down to your lower abdomen, and then raising your left hand to chest level with the palm facing outward, moving it down to your lower abdomen. Finally, return both hands to the sides with palms facing inward.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on lap, then raise right hand to touch chin, palm facing inward, moving from chin to ear. Active sign: repeat the right hand movement to touch chin, palm inward, then return to lap. Repeat the action starting from the same active position before resting.

Prepare by sitting with hands resting on lap, then raise right hand to touch chin, palm facing inward, moving from chin to ear. Active sign: repeat the right hand movement to touch chin, palm inward, then return to lap. Repeat the action starting from the same active position before resting.

Repeat this circular motion twice, ensuring your hand returns to the starting position each time. Finally, return your right hand to your side, keeping your face neutral and your body relaxed.

Prepare by resting your right hand at your side. Start with the right hand raised to the side of the head, palm facing inward. Move the hand downward and across the body, palm facing outward, then return to the starting position. Repeat this motion twice, ensuring the hand returns to the same starting position before resting.

Start with the right hand raised to the side of the head, palm facing inward. Move the hand downward and across the body, palm facing outward, then return to the starting position. Repeat this motion twice, ensuring the hand returns to the same starting position before resting.
